no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held to discuss this application because the application did not raise significant public health questions on the role of treatment with a biologic product for patients with high-risk neuroblastoma.

summary: No advisory committee (ODAC) meeting was convened for Unituxin (dinutuximab); the review documents state the application did not raise significant public health questions and that ODAC is comprised predominantly of adult oncologists. Instead, FDA consulted two Special Government Employees with pediatric oncology expertise and one patient representative, cleared for conflicts of interest, who each opined that dinutuximab provided treatment benefit in high-risk neuroblastoma with an acceptable risk/benefit profile. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
